title: Breadboard the places, actions, and connections
principle: Shape Up breadboarding (public): map screens/places, affordances/actions, and connections at a fat-marker level before polished UI. Keeps AI from pixel-painting unsettled product shape.
procedure: List actions available in each place.
Draw connections (what leads where)—boxes and arrows, not mock chrome.
Only then add visual design or high-fidelity AI renders.
Update the breadboard when scope changes; don’t silently restyle past confusion.
examplePrompts:
Breadboard this feature (Singer / Shape Up):
- Places
- Actions
- Connections
ASCII or nested lists fine—no colors, no typography.
Flag rabbit holes. Then stop; wait for approval before pixels.
Convert this glossy mock back into a breadboard; identify unresolved connections.
promptWhy: Bans chrome until structure is settled.
tips: Fat marker sketches pair with breadboards.

useWhen: The current define task needs this specific principle: Shape Up breadboarding (public): map screens/places, affordances/actions, and connections at a fat-marker level before polished UI. Keeps AI from pixel-painting unsettled product shape.
inputs: A concrete user problem and the current artifact
Constraints, existing behavior and source attribution to preserve
agentContract.output: A bounded application of “Breadboard the places, actions, and connections” with before/after evidence and remaining limitations.
agentContract.recipe:
1. List places (where the user is).
2. List actions available in each place.
3. Draw connections (what leads where)—boxes and arrows, not mock chrome.
4. Only then add visual design or high-fidelity AI renders.
5. Update the breadboard when scope changes; don’t silently restyle past confusion.
acceptance: Show the before/after artifact and explain how “Breadboard the places, actions, and connections” improves the named user task.
No visual styling in the breadboard step.

stateRequirements.responsive: Check 390px and desktop plus 200% zoom; preserve reading order, wrap long text and keep actions reachable.
stateRequirements.accessibility: Use semantic headings and native controls, visible labels and focus; normal text contrast at least 4.5:1.
stateRequirements.keyboard: Complete the primary action using Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter and Space; no pointer-only information or focus trap.
stateRequirements.reducedMotion: Remove nonessential movement; preserve all state and information without waiting for animation.
stateRequirements.loading: Show pending feedback only during real work; retain context and allow navigation away.
stateRequirements.empty: Distinguish no content from no matching results; explain how to proceed or reset filters.
stateRequirements.error: Explain the failed action, retain user input and offer recovery; never claim success on failure.
stateRequirements.interruption: A newer action wins; cancel or ignore stale results and keep controls responsive.
stateRequirements.stateChange: Announce important results politely without moving focus unexpectedly.

compatibility.rule: Start with one technique. Add at most one companion for a distinct unsolved problem; candidates are suggestions, not verified compatibility.
conflicts: Two techniques changing the same visual role require an explicit winner.
Do not combine multiple entrance or attention effects on one target.
Aesthetic subtraction must not remove semantics, feedback or attribution.
compatibility.stop: Stop when the named task is clearer and acceptance evidence is recorded; do not add polish without a problem.
